reviews.concise_rationale: The crop visibly shows the text/BPE input path and the discrete RVQ cell-token input path, with tokenization and detokenization around the LLM interface.
The crop shows the actual prompt fed into DeepSeek and the immediate embedding workflow that follows from the generated gene text.
The crop visibly captures metadata being turned into text prompts for Mixtral-based sample-description generation, including both GEO and CELLxGENE panels.
The crop shows a DeepSeek/Youtu-Embedding gene-embedding workflow, not GPT-OSS-120B or the NCBI/share-GPT dataset construction shown by the target route.
